evidence_levels.L3: falsifiable psychological or causal hypothesis; multiple explanations
evidence_levels.L4: corroborated and prospective evidence, still limited
evidence_levels.NI: not identifiable from trading history alone

inference_types.observed: quantifiable from declared inputs, not necessarily causal
inference_types.hypothesis: must not be stated as diagnosed fact
inference_types.counterfactual: simulation only, dependent on execution assumptions
inference_types.not_identifiable: trading records cannot identify causal background/neural or clinical status

prohibitions: Do not infer childhood environment, family income, trauma, or life history from trades.
Do not infer brain activation, neurotransmitters, ADHD, autism or diagnoses from trades.
Do not label trader as impulsive, addicted or emotionally unstable based only on one behavior.
Do not create empirical metrics, prices, confidence intervals, profits or diagnoses absent data.
Do not claim causality from conditional profit/loss associations.
Do not compute MFE/MAE or path-dependent stops without suitable intrahold price data.
Do not reuse future revised features or optimize and validate on same data.
Do not propose or execute live orders. Preserve hard stops and max risk.
